MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The ten-foot HDMI cable fits my equipment setup needs because it offers more reach than my previous six-foot cable when connecting my Raspberry Pi or other devices.",
    "That cable connects with my pattern of buying practical accessories to make equipment I already own easier to connect and use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV devices offer streaming capabilities, but my recent purchases do not indicate that I need a new way to watch television.",
    "The Echo speakers, smart display, and smart plug assume a need for voice control or home automation that my equipment organization and networking purchases do not establish.",
    "Owning a Kindle does not mean I currently need a larger tablet for apps or video; those are different uses from reading."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Amazon-branded purchases seem to have been treated as interest in more Amazon devices, although the particular job each purchase serves matters more to me.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in streaming and smart-home products without a specific connection to what I am working on."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases emphasize wired networking, carrying my laptop, organizing headphones, and cleaning equipment, which point toward maintaining an existing computer setup.",
    "Details such as cable length, connection type, and compatibility with equipment I already own matter because an accessory needs to solve a concrete problem.",
    "My Raspberry Pi, case, keyboard, and cable purchases fit together as equipment for a project; they do not by themselves imply a need for another entertainment device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but mostly missed my current focus on connecting, organizing, and maintaining equipment I already own."
}
